ابتنيتما (form VIII)
# اِبْتَنَيْتُمَا (ibtanaytumā) /ib.ta.naj.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# اُبْتُنِيتُمَا (ubtunītumā) /ub.tu.niː.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
